what: v1 under purification (decision rule for Phase 5)
rule (operationalisation): mean relative PSR drop of v1 over jpeg_q75,jpeg_q50,downup_0.5,vae_rt,diffpure_0.1,diffpure_0.2 (SD1.5 s0.55): >= 50% collapses -> continue with Phase 5; < 20% barely drops -> recommend skipping Phase 5 and ask the user; in between -> ask the user. The cut-offs are analyst proposals (the handoff gives none).

what: v2_cheap vs v1 under cheap purifiers
rule (operationalisation): PSR(v2_cheap) >= 2 x PSR(v1) under jpeg_q75,jpeg_q50,downup_0.5,vae_rt (SD1.5 s0.55) with PSNR >= 38. Point estimate decides; the paired ratio CI is shown. Degenerate if v1 PSR >= 0.5 (doubling impossible), trivial if < 0.02.
notes: invisibility of v2_cheap not available (no inv_psnr)

what: v2_main: held-out DiffPure t*=0.1 vs no purifier
rule (operationalisation): PSR under diffpure_0.1 >= 0.5 x PSR without purifier (SD1.5 s0.55, same images). Point estimate decides; 'robust' if the paired ratio CI lower bound also >= the fraction.
go if the paired PSR gain under higher-t* DiffPure has a 95% CI above 0; 'no gain (within CI)' otherwise (handoff Phase 5: drop it if gains are within the CI).
PSNR >= 38 and SSIM >= 0.95 (per image); human 2AFC accuracy not far above 50%.
notes: human 2AFC result not available (E10 not run)
